Helpers

API reference

Glossary

On this page

Helpers ​

Small, reusable utilities in app/Helpers and app/Support. Business rules belong in services, not here.

ActivityLogHelper ​

ActivityLogHelper::log(array $logData): void. Writes one activity log entry with the IP and user agent. See Activity logging.

FileUploadHelper ​

MethodReturns
fileUpload(UploadedFile $file, string $feature, ?string $identifier = null, ?string $customFilename = null)the created FileUpload row; the file is stored on the private disk under a UUID name
delete(?FileUpload $file)removes the file from disk and its row
fileSize(?FileUpload $file)bytes, or null if missing
humanReadableSize(?int $bytes)"1.2 MB"

See File uploads.

app/Support ​

Framework-free classes: easy to unit test.

ClassUse
Rbac\PermissionMatrixexpands permission patterns from data/rbac.php ('*', per module, per sub-module) and rejects unknown names
Auth\ClientInfoIP (validated) and user agent of a request
Auth\IssuedTokensresult of login / refresh: access token, access_expires_in, raw refresh token, expiry, session row
